aboutH2: Sage Health Centre: Residential Addiction Treatment in Kamloops, British Columbia
intro: Sage Health Centre takes a personalized approach to addiction treatment, recognizing that each person’s journey towards recovery is unique. Their programs blend traditional 12-Step/SMART philosophy with holistic wellness modalities to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses both physical and mental health. This approach allows clients to not only overcome addiction, but also improve their overall well-being.

The residential program at Sage Health Centre focuses on stabilization and early recovery, providing clients with a safe and supportive environment. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, ensuring that they receive the one-on-one attention they need to process core issues and current concerns. Additionally, clients participate in co-ed and gender-specific groups covering topics such as relapse prevention, personal limits and codependency, and stress management techniques.

Sage Health Centre’s approach is centered around empowering clients to take responsibility for their own recovery. The programs provide tools and resources to help clients build the skills necessary to maintain sobriety and live a healthy life after leaving the centre.

pillars.title: The Benefits of Residential Treatment at Sage Health Centre
pillars.body: Residential treatment provides a unique opportunity for individuals struggling with addiction to receive intensive support in a structured environment. Sage Health Centre’s residential program offers a range of benefits to clients who choose this option. First and foremost, the residential program at Sage Health Centre provides clients with a supportive and safe environment to focus on their recovery. The comfortable and home-like facility allows clients to relax and fully engage in the treatment process. In addition, the program offers individualized care and attention. Clients have access to unlimited individual counseling sessions, which are tailored to their specific needs in order to process core issues and current concerns. Groups are also offered to clients to help establish camaraderie and peer support. Finally, the program at Sage Health Centre guides clients every step of the way, from start to finish. The comprehensive treatment plan provides clients with the tools and resources necessary to achieve and maintain sobriety, and the centre also offers virtual support for family members during the treatment process.

pillars.title: A Relapse Prevention Plan and Aftercare With No End Date
pillars.body: Before discharge, every client writes a detailed relapse prevention plan with a counsellor, naming their own warning signs and what they will do about them. A continuing care plan covers the rest of life at home in Kamloops, the Okanagan or wherever you live: community supports, physical and mental health, work and spiritual life. Once you finish, you can join the alumni groups on Zoom four times a week at no extra cost, for as long as you want. The centre asks people to come weekly for at least six months and suggests one to two years.

pillars.title: A Physician, Counsellors and Support Staff Around the Clock
pillars.body: Medical care is led by Dr. Rob Baker, a BC physician since 1980 who is certified by both the International and the Canadian Society of Addiction Medicine and also works at Royal Inland Hospital. Clinical director Patricia Sekutowska is a registered social worker who draws on her own recovery. Counsellors hold degrees in social work, counselling psychology and psychology, and on average clients meet one to one with a counsellor two or three times a week. Support workers are on site 24 hours a day, with a yoga teacher, two chefs and a housekeeping team rounding out the staff.

overview: Sage Health Centre is a highly reputable rehab center that provides exceptional care and support to adults battling with addiction. Offering a range of 28-84 days of treatment, the facility promises a customized treatment program that is designed to suit each client’s unique needs. Sage Health Centre is committed to providing a safe, healthy, and welcoming environment for its clients and staff, and the team works in partnership with various health authorities and regulatory bodies to ensure that the center operates within the latest guidelines and industry standards. Through evidence-based treatment programs, Sage Health Centre offers hope, healing, and a path towards recovery, helping clients get back on the road to a healthy and fulfilling life.

location.heading: Sage Health Centre in Kamloops, British Columbia
location.intro: Sage Health Centre is on Columbia Street in Kamloops, the main city of BC's Thompson region, where the North and South Thompson rivers meet. Vancouver is about four hours away by the Coquihalla Highway, Kelowna about two hours, Vernon about an hour and a half, Salmon Arm in the Shuswap about an hour and a quarter and Merritt about an hour, and staff will meet clients who arrive by bus or plane.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Sage Health Centre cost?
faqs.a: Sage's published fees run from $14,950 for the 28-day basic program to $44,850 for the 84-day enhanced program. The 42-day program is $22,425 and the 56-day program is $29,900. Meals are included and the virtual aftercare groups are free.

faqs.q: How long does the program last?
faqs.a: The length of the program varies depending on the individual’s needs, but typically lasts 28 to 84 days.

faqs.q: Does Sage Health Centre offer detox?
faqs.a: No, Sage does not provide medically supervised detox. You need at least five days without alcohol or drugs before admission. If that is not safe for you, the admissions team will help you find a detox program through your own health authority first.

faqs.q: Where is Sage Health Centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Sage is at 101 Columbia Street in Kamloops, in BC's Thompson region. It is about four hours from Vancouver by the Coquihalla and about two hours from Kelowna. You can drive yourself and use the secure parking, and staff pick up clients who arrive by bus or plane.

You leave with a written relapse prevention plan and a continuing care plan built with your counsellor. Alumni can join four virtual aftercare groups a week on Zoom at no extra cost, with no end date. The centre recommends attending weekly for at least six months.

faqs.q: Is Sage a private centre? Who can refer me?
faqs.a: Yes, Sage Health Centre is a private, fee-based facility. You can refer yourself, or a family member, counsellor, physician, employer, EFAP or extended medical program can arrange the referral. Admissions starts with a confidential phone screening.
Residential addiction treatment is a program where clients temporarily reside at the treatment centre for an extended period of time to receive intensive support.

faqs.q: Do you have to stay at the treatment centre during the whole program?
faqs.a: Yes, clients in the residential program at Sage Health Centre will reside at the facility for the duration of the program.

faqs.q: What kind of addictions does Sage Health Centre treat?
faqs.a: Sage Health Centre offers addiction treatment for a variety of substances, including alcohol, drugs, and prescription medication.

faqs.q: What is the cost of the program?
faqs.a: The cost of the program varies depending on the length and level of care needed. Contact Sage Health Centre directly for more information.
